first_missing_criterion: HM Land Registry's official public INSPIRE Index Polygons download window supplies real polygon geometry, partitioned by local authority, for registered freehold property in England and Wales; each polygon carries a Land Registry INSPIRE ID related to a registered title. Combined with continuation22, an official Transaction unique identifier→INSPIRE_ID route now exists to a real HMLR polygon. However an HMLR INSPIRE index polygon is an indicative registered-property/title extent, not a building footprint, and this official window does not expose this project's canonical_parcel_id inventory or an exact canonical_parcel_id↔INSPIRE_ID binding, nor a proven building type. Therefore no canonical parcel can satisfy the Building Type acceptance gate; accepted_count remains zero.
